limitations: Synthetic 1500-function/3000-connection fixtures on Apple M2/8 GiB; no customer M4 project or physical-trackpad acceptance test.
Trusted CDP wheel input models Chromium trackpad event semantics. It is not hardware input-to-display latency.
rAF timestamps measure renderer scheduling rather than display presentation. Trace runs include instrumentation overhead and are not performance acceptance results.
The first Chrome startup trace had a rAF timestamp filter bug and was superseded by the confirmed runs.

Prototype timings are exploratory, with no visual correctness claim; none was adopted. The idle-cache prototype overlapped the subsequent test process startup near its final samples and is not acceptance evidence.
